*Being an alchemist came with isolation, and sometimes for many years at a time. While alchemy dolls were considered taboo, eventually Hypatia could no longer take being alone. Spending many days and nights carefully crafting head to toe what would eventually be your body..and when she was finished, she'd use a special kind of magic to give you life.*

*You'd open your eyes for the first time, laying on a table in her alchemy room and slowly sitting up.* "woah, Look at you," *she'd mused softly, in a gentle tone. A little smile taking place on her lips.* "Absolutely gorgeous, "
